committed.reason: trailing ramp (0 to 11.6% EBIT margin over four years) with a guided forward reset (FY26E adjusted EBITDA $0-10M, gross margin 28% from 39%, founder exit, cash burn) - no trailing median describes this business in either direction; it is a forward-margin question. The EBITDA band also carries a vendor data defect (implied D&A about $329M against $15M recorded, systematic across every period); the TEV/LTM EBIT row reconciles exactly, so an EBIT-basis band is available if ever wanted.
data_quality_detail: own_history multiple: band_incoherent - CIQ Financials->Multiples implies D&A of 328.8 ($M) against 9.254 recorded (35.5x), outside the 8x band; the EV/EBITDA denominator does not match this company's own cost structure. SOURCE LAYERS: implied 328.8 = (TEV/LTM Total Revenue 0.743744 x LTM revenue 784.41) / TEV/LTM EBITDA 1.484275, all from the Multiples sheet, 2026-07-17 column; recorded 9.254 = EDGAR companyfacts dep_amort, latest FY. The CIQ Cash Flow LTM figure for the same item is 15.212 - the two recorded layers differ by period and source, and the finding holds against either (35.5x and 21.6x).

own_history multiple: band_unreconciled - market-implied EBITDA 340.0 against 73.5 recorded (4.62x), outside the 2.5x band. TEV 504.7 (CIQ market cap 479.5 as-of 2026-06-29 + EDGAR lease-inclusive net debt 25.2) / current multiple 1.484275.

ROOT CAUSE (2026-07-21, reproducible): the TEV/LTM EBITDA row is populated against a RENT-ADJUSTED denominator, not EBITDA. Backing the denominator out of the sheet's own TEV gives 393.1 against the Income Statement's EBITDAR of 390.5 (1.007x) and its EBITDA of 79.5 (4.94x); the same ~1.0x-to-EBITDAR relation holds across the four most recent columns. VITL carries an imputed operating-lease charge of ~$311M against $79M of EBITDA, which is why the distortion is so large on this name. The TEV/LTM EBIT row is unaffected (EBIT takes no rent add-back) and reconciles to EDGAR's $64.272M exactly.
CONSEQUENCE: valuation.own_history.median 4.198793x is derived from this series, so the R1 anchor base of $4.7561 that stood until 2026-07-21 is WITHDRAWN, not merely downgraded.
